data.one_liner: Connects Flutter apps to a Meteor backend over DDP for methods and subscriptions.
data.what_it_does: It provides a client to connect Flutter applications to Meteor backends via DDP over WebSockets. It supports method calls, reactive data collections exposed as streams, authentication flows, and automatic reconnection with backoff.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application with a Meteor backend.
You need reactive streams for Meteor collections and user authentication status.
avoid_when: Your backend does not use Meteor or the DDP protocol.
You require an integrated client-side minimongo database.
strengths: Seamless integration with StreamBuilder and FutureBuilder.
Automatic reconnection with exponential backoff and session re-login.
weaknesses: No built-in minimongo cache on the client side.
In-flight method calls are not automatically retried after a disconnection.
